position_overview: Recruitment Marketing Specialist Job Description Position Title: Recruitment Marketing Specialist Position Summary The Recruitment Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies that attract top talent and strengthen the organization's employer brand. This role partners closely with Talent Acquisition to create engaging campaigns, optimize candidate outreach, and improve the overall candidate experience across multiple recruitment channels. The ideal candidate is creative, data-driven, and passionate about storytelling, digital marketing, and talent attraction. This role reports directly to the Sr Marketing Manager. Key Responsibilities Employer Branding Develop and maintain the company's employer brand across digital and social platforms. Create compelling content showcasing company culture, employee stories, benefits, and career opportunities. Ensure consistent employer brand messaging across all recruitment materials and channels. Recruitment Marketing Campaigns Plan and execute recruitment marketing campaigns to support hiring initiatives and workforce growth. Manage job advertising strategies across job boards, social media, email campaigns, and other sourcing platforms. Coordinate targeted campaigns for high-volume, hard-to-fill, and specialized roles. Content Creation Design and produce recruitment-related content including: Social media posts Videos Graphics Career site content Email campaigns Event materials Collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather employee testimonials and success stories. Digital & Social Media Management Manage recruitment-focused social media channels and content calendars. Monitor engagement metrics and optimize campaigns based on performance data. Stay current on recruitment marketing trends, tools, and best practices. Career Site & Candidate Experience Maintain and optimize the company careers page for engagement and conversion. Improve the candidate journey through clear communication and engaging recruitment touchpoints. Support initiatives that enhance candidate engagement and application completion rates. Analytics & Reporting Track and analyze recruitment marketing metrics such as: Source effectiveness Application conversion rates Campaign performance Cost-per-applicant Candidate engagement Provide regular reports and recommendations to leadership and Talent Acquisition team
